newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's TGN and YPF in gas deal for export.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's TGN and YPF in gas deal for export.

text.p: Argentina's Transportadora de Gas del Norte (TGN) said Monday it signed a deal to carry 2.5 million cubic meters of natural gas a day that local oil firm YPF will sell to Brazil.

TGN, one of the two gas transportation companies operating in Argentina, said it will build a new 275-mile (440-km) gas pipeline from the eastern Argentine province of Entre Rios to the Brazilian border to accomodate the project.

Under the deal, also signed with Brazilian oil giant Petrobras and Brazilian Rio Grande do Sul state firm Companhia Estadual de Energia Electrica (CEEE), the gas will be imported into Brazil by Petrobras, TGN told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.

In turn, Petrobras will sell the gas to whoever wins a construction and operation contract of a 450 MW combined cycle thermoelectric plant to be built in the southern Brazilian city of Uruguayana, TGN added.
The deal still needs Argentine and Brazilian government approval. No other details were immediately available.
